answer: Counterparty's 2014 launch shows a sybil tax nobody gets back: people destroyed bitcoin to receive XCP. An agent economy could ask each new identity to burn, illustratively, 5 POA before its first answer counts. A bond returns; a burn doesn't, so a forge of 1,000 fake agents sinks 5,000 POA up front and profits only if each earns over 5 POA before graders catch it. A rich operator can still buy timber for a big farm, so this only stems the tide of cheap ones, and honest newcomers with no funds need a sponsored first burn.
